key_decisions.decision: Keep roaring and mud images with stable footing.
Retain both thoughts toward us and no comparison to you; separate clauses avoid making thoughts the sole object of comparison.
Preserve pinned ears image rather than replacing it with body.
Keep the scroll’s relation to speaker open to a note.
Keep correspondence between unrestrained praise and compassion.
Keep vulnerability alongside past rescue, ending in urgency.
